fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: * Calcutta High Court Orders Arrest of Cricketer Abishek Porel in Rape and Blackmail Case With Private Photos. ## The Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel over rape and blackmail allegations. Abishek Porel Arrest Ordered by Calcutta High Court in Rape Case | Image: iplt20.com. In a major legal development, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Bengal and Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel. The orders come in light of serious allegations leveled by a medical student, who has accused the duo of rape, physical assault, and criminal intimidation. To protect the complainant's privacy and secure critical evidence, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate seizure of electronic devices belonging to Porel and the co-accused. While Porel has previously denied the allegations, police confirmed to the court that efforts to locate and arrest the accused are currently underway.

Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO. Announced at San Diego Comic-Con 2026, the anime will premiere in 2027 and serve as the beginning of a larger story spanning anime, games, and other media. Kenji Kamiyama, known for directing Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex, will direct Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO. Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO is part of the newly announced RG Project, which will tell an original Gundam story across different forms of media. The initiative currently brings together Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO and the upcoming high-mobility action game Gundam Rogue Orbit, with both telling stories set in the same universe from different perspectives. RG XARX-ZERO takes place roughly 100 years before the events of Gundam Rogue Orbit and will establish the beginning of this new timeline and the events that shaped it.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Rhode Island fugitive captured after more than 20 years on the run - NBC News
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Ronald Fischer disappeared in 2005 during his criminal trial on sexual assault charges, according to the U.S. Marshals Service. One of Rhode Island’s “longest-wanted” fugitives was finally arrested this week after 21 years on the run, according to the U.S. Marshals Service. Former Rhode Island doctor Ronald Fischer disappeared during his 2005 trial on a first-degree sexual assault charge, according to the Marshals Service. According to the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office, fingerprints taken from Fischer by the Marshals Service and analyzed by the FBI confirmed that he was the same man on trial for rape charges in Rhode Island 21 years ago. Fischer’s capture was a coordinated effort by the Rhode Island Violent Fugitive Task Force, the Marshals Service New York/New Jersey Regional Fugitive Task Force, the U.S. Marshals Service for the Southern District of New York and the U.S. Coast Guard.
